name: Saturated fat
what_is: Saturated fat is a group of fats whose fatty acids contain no double bonds. Different saturated fatty acids can behave differently, but nutrition labels usually declare them together as one value.
why_botia: The saturated fat value groups several different fatty acids into a single number. BOTIA keeps that declared amount separate from the regulatory references and evidence used to interpret it.
can_1: Read the saturated fat value declared on the nutrition label and preserve its unit and basis.
can_2: Keep saturated fat separate from total fat and other fat subtypes.
can_3: Connect the declared value with the applicable regulatory information and documented evidence.
cannot_1: Determine which individual saturated fatty acids make up the declared value.
cannot_2: Determine how each fatty acid contributes to the total from the nutrition label alone.
cannot_3: Determine an individual's appropriate saturated fat intake from the nutrition label.
cannot_4: Treat an undeclared saturated fat value as zero.
